text_block_list.text:
Idiot... Are you dreaming about the
concert?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
You two, it looks like they've brought out
dessert. Although, Ticket
already seems to
be out of fuel.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I'll just go grab some cake for the three of
us. Taishin, please continue
to keep an eye
on Ticket.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, will do... I swear, Ticket. You're like
a preschooler, running
around till you fall
asleЭпизод..
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text: Huh?! Hey! Wake up! Get off of me!
text_block_list.name: Нарита Таисин

text_block_list.text:
Hey, there... What are two youngins like
yourselves doing sighing at a
party? Or,
are you having another "dreamland"
moment?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Exactly that... Being able to sing with you,
Teio, and even Rudolf! It
still doesn't feel
real.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
More than that, it was a lot of fun! Again...
I wish to do it again and
again!
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
The stage lights were so, so bright, if you
ask me, but...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I figure so long as we keep running in
races, we'll be able to go up
there
countless times.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
What?! Nature is gonna sing with Satono
and the others again! Not
fair, not fair! I
wanna sing with them too!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
So do I... That's why we'll have to keep
running too.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's right! Okay, then, let's
charge forward!
text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What's gotten into you all of a
sudden?! That hurts! Oof!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
